provenance: Derived from IRSA TAP spherex.artifact JOIN spherex.plane metadata (snapshot.json); no pixel data is stored here.

wavelengthPolicy.planeBounds: Plane-level energy bounds describe the whole detector band; they are NOT the wavelength at the target pixel (linear variable filters).
wavelengthPolicy.wcsWave: Wavelength at the target pixel is only recorded when the cutout's WCS-WAVE table was evaluated for that observation (scripts/fetch-spherex.py).
